name: ThemeProductList
description: StandardRail-based theme product list with a two-slot image-led content panel, overlay and description before the product cards.

figma.notes: English Site Optimization 2026 ANUA Cleanse & Reset product-list-pc / list. The leading content panel is two product-card slots wide.

title.description: Visible list heading and accessible section label.

products.description: Product cards rendered after the two-slot theme content panel.

content.description: Image, overlay title/description and optional destination link for the reserved two-slot panel.

mobileSurface.description: Mobile-only section surface. Card preserves the inset rounded panel. Plain is full-bleed with 16px content padding and honors dividerPosition/dividerVariant.

dividerPosition.description: Places the section boundary above, below, or removes it. On mobile it is honored only by the plain surface.

dividerVariant.description: Gray renders the 1px structural separator; black renders the theme-aware 2px emphasis separator.

onAddToCart.description: Reports the product whose independent quick-add action was pressed.

previousLabel.description: Accessible label for the previous rail action.

nextLabel.description: Accessible label for the next rail action.

focus.note: The optional content link and composed ProductList controls keep the shared focus treatment.

radius.note: The content panel uses the component radius token.

motion.note: Rail navigation and reduced-motion behavior come from ProductList.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Labelled product list with a semantic theme image panel, optional link and native product controls.
accessibility.structure: The content panel is the first list item and its image requires meaningful alt text; product cards remain independent list items.
accessibility.interaction: The optional content link and ProductList rail navigation remain keyboard reachable and respect reduced motion.
